# toUpperCase

<link-summary>Raises a string to upper case, optionally tidying its whitespace.</link-summary>

<web-summary>toUpperCase() — Raises a string to upper case, optionally tidying its whitespace. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>lang/string</code> · Since: 1.0.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function toUpperCase(value: string, options: ToUpperCaseOptions = {}): string;
```

The counterpart of `toLowerCase`, with the same validation and the same optional `trim`.

## Parameters

| Parameter                     | Type                 | Description                                                                  |
| :---------------------------- | :------------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `value`                       | `string`             | The string to convert. It must not be empty.                                 |
| `options` _(optional)_ `= {}` | `ToUpperCaseOptions` | `trim` trims the string and collapses runs of whitespace into single spaces. |

## Returns

`string` — the upper-cased string.

## Throws

| Exception              | Condition                               |
| :--------------------- | :-------------------------------------- |
| `EmptyStringException` | the value is not a string, or is empty. |

## Examples

### Converting

```javascript
toUpperCase("Hello"); // => "HELLO"
```
